measurement_scope: Dense stateless: nine N/method geometries, 500 steps, one warmup, three calls. Schedule/Doppler/moving: maintained default comparison and acceptance gates. CSR: independent SciPy reference and three fresh repetitions per size in genuine installed/absent-kernel environments. Stateful comparison: all eight maintained variants, aggregate wall time for 1000 public steps at N=16; only ordinary UPDE slots are asserted Rust/NumPy by kernel availability. Phase edge/JAX: first call separated from three raw repetitions. Browser: actual compute and readback including coupled recovery; timings include buffer upload and submission.
precision_scope: Five CPU implementations use float64. JAX host and functional Kuramoto were executed in float32 and float64 on CPU. Browser WebGPU Euler uses float32 on Google SwiftShader, a software fallback adapter.
raw_sample_boundary: The maintained dense stateless CLI reports means; the maintained stateful CLI reports formatted aggregate times. No per-call samples or quantiles were emitted by those CLIs. CSR and phase edge records retain their emitted raw repetitions. Do not interpret aggregates as P50 or infer a causal speedup across different NumPy environments.
source_state: Measured numerical sources and benchmark drivers before the atomic local commit; per-job hashes identify the measured bytes. Two test docstrings were subsequently corrected to British English, with unchanged executable AST including locations; documentation_only_source_deltas records both measured and current hashes.
